title: Understanding Residuals
text: In an Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) regression, the residuals are the differences between the observed values and the predicted values. They represent the error in the predictions.

title: Orthogonality in OLS
text: Orthogonality in the context of OLS regression means that the residuals are perpendicular to the column space of the design matrix. This is a key property of the least squares solution.

title: Geometric Interpretation
text: Think of the design matrix as a plane in a high-dimensional space. The residuals being orthogonal means they are at a right angle to this plane, minimizing the distance from the observed data points to the plane.
